वर् {c10c} U. (व रयति-ते, strictly caus.
of वृ, or वॄ of class {c10c}) To ask for,
choose, seek to get; see वृ.

.
--Comp.

a goose, gander.

seed of the mango. {5} a curl on a
horse's neck. {6} a conch-shell.

salt.

वरम् ind. Rather or better than,
preferably to, it is better that &c.
It is sometimes used with the
ablative; समुन्नयन् भूतिमनार्यसंगमाद्वरं
विरोधोपि समं महात्मभिः

. But
it is generally used absolutely, वरं
being used with the clause
containing the thing preferred, and न च, न
तु, or न पुनः with the clause
containing the thing to which the first is
preferred, (both being put in the
nominative case); वरं मौनं कार्यं न च
वचनमुक्तं यदनृतं… वरं भिक्षाशित्वं न च
परधनास्वादनसुखं

; वरं प्राणत्यागो न
पुनरधमानामुपगमः ibid.; sometimes न
is used without च, तु or पुनः; याच्ञा
मोघा वरमधिगुणे नाधमे लब्धकामा
